extDescription: A knowledge map for your notes. One click puts a formula from your AI chat in the right place.

error.modelNotConfigured: Set up a model in settings first.
error.baseUrlProtocol: The base URL must start with http:// or https://.
error.mapTooDeep: A map has at most 4 levels.

site.noteRequestPlaceholder: How to note it? e.g. keep the table (Enter: the usual)

toast.noMap: No map is open. Open one in the side panel, or
toast.createMapAndRecord: create a map and add this

command.record: Add the selection to the map

menu.recordQuote: Keep word for word in Chat2Know map

panel.noModel: No model set up yet. Recording still works, but new notes wait in "Unplaced" until you drag them into place.
panel.mapsHint: Your maps (notes go into the open one)
panel.pickMap: Open a map above, or create one. What you record goes into the map you open.
panel.hint: Click ＋ beside a formula in an answer, or select text and press Alt S, and it goes to the right place on your map.
panel.hintNoModel: Drag an item by ⋮⋮ onto any topic. Once a model is set up, unplaced notes find their places.

empty.title: Your knowledge map grows here
empty.body: While you chat with an AI, select what is worth keeping and one click puts it in the right place on your map. When your questions start going in circles, it nudges you here.
empty.local: Your data stays in this browser

sites.note: Ticking a site asks the browser for access to that site only. On other pages, use the shortcut or the right-click menu.

mapPage.legendOutline: In the outline, not learned yet
mapPage.hint: Drag a node to move it; double-click to edit its text.
mapPage.pickTopic: Pick a topic to see what is recorded under it.
mapPage.empty: No maps yet. Record your first note in an AI chat, or start a map here.

settings.modelExplain: Places your notes, shortens long selections, answers questions about a selection and notices when you are stuck. Any OpenAI-compatible service works.
settings.embedding: Embedding model (optional, places notes more accurately)
settings.keyNote: The key stays in this browser. Only what you record, and the questions you choose to record, are sent to this service.
settings.sitesExplain: Show ＋ beside formulas on these sites
settings.recordAsks: Also record the questions I send on these sites, to notice when I am stuck
settings.recordAsksNote: Kept in this browser; sent to the model above in batches for analysis.
settings.importNote: Import takes a JSON export of this extension, or an export of the old v0.1.
settings.permissionNote: When you save, the browser asks for access to this address; it is used only to call your model.

outline.askFirst: This is your first note in "$1". Shall I lay out the course's outline?
outline.ask: Shall I lay out the outline of "$1"?
outline.explain: The outline is grey. It only shows what the whole course covers and where your notes are; it is not your notes. What you record later goes to its place in it.
outline.tocPlaceholder: Paste your textbook's table of contents
outline.footer: Black is what you recorded, grey is the outline. The less grey, the more of the course you have covered.

onboard.stepSites: ② Use it on these sites
onboard.recordAsks: Also record the questions I send on these sites, to notice when I get stuck. Kept in this browser; turn it off any time.
onboard.mapPlaceholder: Map name (optional, named from its content)
onboard.animationLabel: A formula selected in an answer flies into the map under its topic

ask.title: Ask · about the selection
ask.firstPlaceholder: What would you like to know?
ask.note: This conversation isn't kept; add a useful answer to the map. Your questions go into your question log.
ask.interrupted: The answer was interrupted. Ask again.

stuck.circling: Your latest questions seem to go in circles
stuck.stuck: Something earlier may be holding you up
stuck.offTargetAt: The questions about “$1” may be missing the point
stuck.offTarget: The questions may be missing the point
stuck.phrasingAt: A clearer question about “$1” may help
stuck.footer: Looked at every 5 new questions, only here in the side panel. "Not now" keeps this map quiet for today.

questions.empty: No questions recorded yet. The questions you send on the ticked sites, and in the Ask window, appear here.
questions.noReport: No report yet. "New report" has the model write an analysis of the $1 questions in this map.
questions.noAsksInMap: No questions in this map yet. A report is written from them.
questions.noModel: Set up a model in settings to write a report.
questions.reportNote: Written by the model from your questions, only when you click "New report"; earlier reports stay in the date menu. No scores.
questions.pickMap: Choose a map to see its report.
